messages:
Owen Park: Hi everyone  first day here (Owen, AE). Quick blockers: I can't open the AE playbook and I don't see HubSpot/Gong in my app launcher. Who do I ping for seats and where is the canonical quick-start?

IT Ops: Welcome Owen! Please open an IT provisioning ticket or paste this snippet into the portal:
```
product: Sales tools
requester: Owen Park
email: owen.park@redwood.example
access: HubSpot (full), Gong (seat), Drive: /Sales/Playbooks/AE-Onboarding-2024
priority: standard
needed-by: 2024-08-10
```
Reply with the ticket ID here and we'll triage.

Owen Park: Ticket submitted as REQ-6789. Thanks! Also can someone share the short discovery cheat sheet and the objection one-pager?

Rina (enablement): Hey Owen  welcome! Canonical playbook is in Drive: https://drive.redwood.company/sales/playbooks/AE-Onboarding-2024. Start with "Discovery 8Q" and "Deal Qualification checklist" in QuickRefs. I'll add you to the folder and drop the 5-min objection one-pager into your Drive.

Dario (CS): For handoffs use the "CS Handoff" template in Playbooks/Templates. If you want a sandbox lead to practice, I can create one after you confirm HubSpot access.

IT Ops: REQ-6789 status: provisioning in progress. ETA a few hours; if SSO mapping fails we'll send direct invites. We'll post invite links here when done.

onboarding-bot: Welcome Owen Park! Onboarding checklist created: /onboarding/checklists/owen_park_1746001234. Tasks: Accept HubSpot invite, Watch Gong intro (10m), Shadow session x2, Practice logging in sandbox lead.

Rina (enablement): Quick Gong tips: enable auto-tagging (Settings -> Call Tags) and subscribe to the "AE discovery" folder in Gong for calibration recordings. Also clone the "AE-Outbound" sequence from HubSpot -> Sequences/shared-AE.

Owen Park: Thanks  REQ-6789 updated says HubSpot seat granted and Gong invite sent. I got both invites but Gong 403 when I try to open the team folder.

IT Ops: Thanks for the heads up. Can you paste a screenshot of the 403? If it's SSO mapping we'll force remap the account and resend the invite.

Owen Park: Uploaded screenshot to REQ-6789.

IT Ops: Remapped SSO for owen.park@redwood.example and resent the Gong invite. You should have access now.

Owen Park: Able to log in to Gong and access the playbook. Thanks all. Rina, I'll take the 10-min objection cheat and the Discovery 8Q now. See you at the shadow session Friday. :rocket:

Rina (enablement): Perfect  added you to the "Week1 - AE Onboarding" calendar and shared the objection one-pager. Ping here if anything else blocks. Welcome aboard! :tada:
